article.headline: Second Storm System Brings Widespread Flood Risk Across Arizona This Weekend
article.summary: Phoenix will see rain chances increase Saturday night through Sunday as a second storm system moves through the region.
article.body:
Residents across Arizona should prepare for a long-duration rain event that arrives Saturday night and continues through Sunday. While Saturday begins with quiet, partly cloudy conditions, moisture will push into the region by the evening, bringing widespread rainfall that is expected to continue through the following day. This secondary storm system follows an initial round of thunderstorms that triggered a flood warning for the northeast Valley and Maricopa County.

A flood watch covers most of Arizona from Saturday night through Monday morning, highlighting a persistent risk of flooding in urban areas, canyons, and low water crossings. Because this event involves on-and-off rain for several hours, water accumulation could occur even if the individual storms are not considered severe. Drivers and residents in low-lying areas should remain alert as river levels are expected to rise to flood stage in certain spots.

Temperatures in Phoenix are expected to drop throughout the weekend, with a high of 78 degrees on Saturday followed by a high of 70 degrees on Sunday. According to AZ Family and FOX 10 Phoenix, the rain will begin to move out of the area by Sunday evening, though lingering showers may persist in eastern Arizona into Monday morning. The start of the workweek should remain quiet in Phoenix as drier air moves into the region. For those planning outdoor activities, trick-or-treat hours are currently expected to be dry for most of the state before the moisture arrives.

article.headline: Diana Shnaider Claws Back from Near Defeat to Clinch Tokyo Semifinal Spot
article.summary: Diana Shnaider rallied to beat Alexandra Eala 2-6, 7-6(5), 6-4 in a grueling 2-hour and 52-minute quarterfinal on Friday.
article.body:
In a match featuring 88 total groundstroke winners, Diana Shnaider overcame a massive deficit to defeat Alexandra Eala in the Toray Pan Pacific Open quarterfinals. Shnaider found herself just two points away from elimination during a tense second-set tiebreak before rallying to turn the momentum in her favor. By the third set, the Russian player tightened her game significantly, committing only two unforced errors to close out the contest.

This victory marks Shnaider’s fifth semifinal appearance of the 2026 season. For tennis fans, the matchup is becoming a must-watch event, as the two rising stars have now faced off in intense battles for two consecutive weeks. Following her victory at the BNB Ningbo Open earlier in October, Shnaider has now established a 2-0 record in this emerging rivalry.

According to the WTA, the match displayed a high level of technical skill from both sides. Eala initially dominated the opening set, demonstrating strong defensive prowess by fending off eight break points and stringing together five consecutive games. However, Shnaider remained persistent, noting after the match that she focused on fighting for every point despite facing an opponent she described as playing at an insane level.

Shnaider now advances to face 18-year-old Slovakian wild card Mia Pohankova. Pohankova reached the final four after a notable victory against qualifier Alycia Parks. Meanwhile, Eala is set to turn her attention toward the upcoming Hong Kong Tennis Open following her exit in Tokyo.

article.headline: Binance co-founder Zhao asks Elon Musk for support after $6.3 billion hack
article.summary: Changpeng Zhao requested that Elon Musk cease mocking the cryptocurrency exchange following a $6.3 billion heist on Thursday.
article.body:
Changpeng Zhao reminded the SpaceX CEO that Binance holds over $1 billion in SpaceX equity, an investment stemming from a previous $500 million stake in the takeover of Twitter. The request for support followed a series of laughing and grimacing emojis posted by Musk on X in response to the record-breaking security breach. Zhao emphasized that this was a poor time to troll the platform as it navigates the aftermath of the theft.

This incident marks the largest cryptocurrency heist ever recorded, according to reports from blockchain firms. The scale of the loss highlights the vulnerability of major digital asset exchanges to state-sponsored entities. With $3 billion in assets already frozen, the exchange is attempting to manage the fallout of an attack currently being attributed to the North Korean state-sponsored unit known as TraderTraitor.

The public dispute between Zhao and Musk follows a history of online friction between the two figures. In 2021, the pair clashed when Musk labeled Binance’s suspension of Dogecoin withdrawals as shady, prompting Zhao to draw a comparison to a massive Tesla vehicle recall. The current tension underscores the delicate relationship between major crypto infrastructure and the tech moguls who frequently comment on the industry.

Binance confirmed on Friday that it has officially restored deposits to the exchange following a temporary freeze of all user activity that was implemented immediately after the hack was detected. The exchange continues to work alongside investigators to address the stolen funds and stabilize the platform for its users worldwide.

news.title: Red Baron worker from Michigan 'blown away' after prank sparks fundraiser

article.headline: Strangers Raise Nearly 600,000 Dollars After Viral Prank Targets Pizza Worker
article.summary: A Michigan grocery store employee received massive financial support after a video of him confronting a prankster went viral.
article.body:
Walt Z., a Red Baron worker stocking pizzas at a Meijer store, told an unidentified prankster that his life is hard enough as he works long hours to support his four children. The confrontation occurred when the individual pretended to steal money from him using a fake Apple Pay transaction sound, prompting Walt to explain he had missed time with his family and faced early morning shifts at ten other locations. 

The emotional response triggered a global reaction online, with thousands of people donating to a GoFundMe account to assist him with his financial struggles, including his mortgage payments. The support underscores a widespread public rejection of public pranking behavior that targets hardworking service employees already managing personal and professional stress. 

According to Yahoo and NBC 5 Chicago, the fundraiser has surpassed 480,000 dollars, with NBC 5 reporting the total is nearing 600,000 dollars as of October 30. Red Baron publicly stood by their employee, stating on social media that "employee of the month" nominations are now closed because they already have their winner. 

Walt Z. stated through the fundraiser that he is overwhelmed by the kindness shown to him and his family. While he has received numerous interview requests, he is currently prioritizing his family's privacy and considering his next steps carefully to ensure he is treated with respect.

Every launch approved by the installation’s range is designated by the federal government to advance economic growth, strengthen national security, and achieve critical national space objectives, reinforcing the Central Coast’s role as a global gateway to space.
